title: Sneakers Come With An Anti-Blister Setting
hook: The eyelet nobody uses is the one that stops the blister.

cast.note: Bill has walked too far in bad shoes. Physical comedy is allowed here, gently.

scenes.note: Find the eyelet. It is set BACK from the others — that offset is the visual tell.

beats.action: a sneaker in profile; laces threaded through every hole but the last
the unused eyelet circles teal, sitting slightly back from the row
a NEVER USED label lands beside it
Bill pokes a finger through the unused eyelet
beats.sync: secondary action — closes a pacing gap

scenes.note: Instructional and clear. The viewer should be able to copy this.

beats.action: the shoe isolates on a plain field, laces drawn in bold
the lace feeds through the extra eyelet on each side
two small loops form above the ankle and hold
the shoe rotates a few degrees so both eyelets read clearly
beats.sync: secondary action — closes a pacing gap

beats.action: the lace end feeds through and pulls taut
beats.sync: secondary action — closes a pacing gap

scenes.note: The crossing is the mechanism. Show the collar closing, not just the lace moving.

beats.action: each lace end crosses toward the opposite loop
the laces thread through the opposing loops
the ankle collar cinches closed; arrows show the grip moving from midfoot to ankle
both lace ends draw across and settle into position
beats.sync: secondary action — closes a pacing gap

beats.action: the cinched collar holds; the laces pull a little tighter
beats.sync: secondary action — closes a pacing gap

scenes.note: Side-by-side cutaway of the heel: lifting versus held. The contrast carries the payoff.

beats.action: cutaway of a heel inside a shoe, lifting free with each step
the locked version draws beside it; the heel stays seated
the cutaway shoe rocks once through a full step
beats.sync: secondary action — closes a pacing gap

scenes.note: Name the consequence, then end on Bill actually using it. No gloating.

beats.action: friction marks scrub back and forth at the heel of the unlocked shoe
a coral hotspot blooms at the rub point on the unlocked shoe only
Bill laces the extra eyelet and walks off; hard cut
